CanvasPreset.Description.zh: 调整当前画布，或保存可重复使用的画布预设。
CanvasPreset.Description.en: Adjust this canvas or save reusable canvas presets.

CanvasPreset.Scope.zh: 预设保存背景、网格样式、透视开关和行列数。校准四角保留在当前画布中。
CanvasPreset.Scope.en: Presets save the background, grid style, perspective switch and grid counts. Calibration corners stay with the current canvas.

CanvasPreset.New.zh: 将当前画布保存为预设
CanvasPreset.New.en: Save this canvas as a preset

CanvasPreset.InvalidLibrary.en: The canvas preset library is invalid.

CanvasPreset.ReadOnly.zh: 自定义预设暂不可用，现有文件保持不变。
CanvasPreset.ReadOnly.en: Custom presets are unavailable. The existing file is preserved.
